description: SPEC-derived bonding-curve quote vectors. Web asserts these in curve.ts. When Launchpad lands, forge tests should assert the same outputs from quoteBuy / quoteSell.

rounding.buy: fee rounds up on incoming ETH, then tokensOut = floor(vToken * ethNet / (vETH + ethNet)). Last-buy cost for remaining supply rounds up; excess ETH is not consumed.
rounding.sell: ethOut = floor(vETH * tokensIn / (vToken + tokensIn)), capped at real ETH. Fee rounds up on ethOut. Seller receives ethOut - fee.

vectors.name: spec-toy-first-buy
vectors.note: SPEC Price section: ETH reserve 10, token reserve 100, deposit 10 → 50. Formula only, no fee.

vectors.name: spec-toy-second-buy
vectors.note: SPEC Price section: after the first buy, another 10 → floor(50 * 10 / 30) = 16.

vectors.name: start-buy-0.001-eth
vectors.note: SPEC Fees: 0.001 ETH takes a 0.0000125 fee and puts 0.0009875 into the curve. ~16.6% of curve supply.

vectors.name: sell-back-after-0.001
vectors.note: SPEC Fees: selling the 0.001 ETH fill back yields about 0.000975 after the second 1.25%.

vectors.name: second-buy-0.001
vectors.note: Another 0.001 ETH after the first fill. Price has moved; same money buys fewer tokens.

vectors.name: graduate-from-start
vectors.note: A buy larger than remaining supply fills only CURVE_SUPPLY. Real ETH at graduation is 0.02. Excess is not consumed.

vectors.name: buy-1-wei-rounds-fee-up
vectors.note: Fee on 1 wei rounds up to 1, so ethNet is 0 and no tokens come out.

vectors.name: buy-10000-wei
vectors.note: ceil(10000 * 125 / 10000) = 125. Tokens use the remaining 9875 wei as ethNet.
